subject: art-and-design
topicName: the creative process from brief to outcome

steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The creative process is not linear — you move between research, experimentation, development and reflection in cycles. | Key Fact: Starting points can come from anywhere: a theme, an object, a technique, an artist, a memory, a place — but you must DEVELOP from them, not just illustrate them. | Key Fact: Your sketchbook is the EVIDENCE of your creative journey — it should show your thinking, experiments, decisions and reflections, not just finished pieces. | Key Fact: Critical reflection and evaluation are essential — they show you understand your own creative process and can make informed decisions.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Create a series of experimental studies exploring the creative process from brief to outcome.
